meta.name: vertex-ai-media-master
meta.description: Execute automatic activation for all google vertex ai multimodal operations operations. Use when appropriate context detected. Trigger with relevant phrases based on skill purpose.

copy.tagline: 用 Vertex AI 自动生成与处理图片、视频等多模态内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想用 Google 的 AI 模型自动处理各种媒体素材
copy.tagline_en: Automate multimodal media generation and processing with Google Vertex AI.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to harness Google's AI for media tasks.

howto.what: 当对话涉及Google Cloud的Vertex AI多模态媒体任务时,Claude会自动启动该技能,生成图像、音频,并分析视频或制作营销素材。使用前需配置好Google Cloud项目和相应权限。
howto.when: 当对话涉及图像生成、视频分析、音频制作等Vertex AI多模态任务时自动触发。配置好项目与凭据后即可使用。

say.text: 帮我分析这个竞品广告视频,提取关键信息和行动号召。
say.note: 将调用Gemini 2.5 Pro生成带时间戳的分析报告。

say.text: 根据产品简介生成4张主视觉图,并配一段30秒背景音乐。
say.note: 同时调用Imagen 4和Lyria生成图片与音频。

say.text: 把这段10分钟演示视频提炼成3个15秒的短视频片段。
say.note: 输出时间戳、字幕建议和故事板摘要。

howto.what_en: When a task involves Google Cloud Vertex AI multimodal media operations, Claude automatically activates this skill to generate images, audio, analyze videos, and create marketing assets. Requires a configured Google Cloud project and credentials.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the conversation involves Vertex AI multimodal tasks such as image generation, video analysis, or audio production, once project setup is complete.

say_en.text: Analyze this competitor ad video and extract key messages and CTAs.
say_en.note: Uses Gemini 2.5 Pro to produce a timestamped analysis report.

say_en.text: Generate 4 hero images from this product brief and a 30-second background track.
say_en.note: Calls Imagen 4 and Lyria for images and audio.

say_en.text: Turn this 10-minute demo video into 3 fifteen-second clips.
say_en.note: Outputs timestamps, captions, and storyboard summaries.
